name: POS Sales Trend by Terminal and Store
query: SELECT posting_date as `Date:Date:120`, SUM(CASE WHEN pos_profile='MG Road - POS 1' THEN base_grand_total ELSE 0 END) as `MG Road - POS 1:Currency:150`, SUM(CASE WHEN pos_profile='MG Road - POS 2' THEN base_grand_total ELSE 0 END) as `MG Road - POS 2:Currency:150` FROM `tabSales Invoice` WHERE is_pos=1 AND docstatus=1 AND is_return=0 GROUP BY posting_date ORDER BY posting_date
report_name: POS Sales Trend by Terminal and Store
